{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# 1. Filter for completed orders
completed = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']
print(f'Number of completed orders: {len(completed)}')

# 2. Convert revenue from string to float
# Strip commas and cast to float
completed['revenue_clean'] = completed['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# 3. Identify and remove QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
qa_mask = completed['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99
print(f'Number of QA orders found: {qa_mask.sum()}')

# Remove QA orders
cleaned = completed[~qa_mask]

# 4. Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = cleaned['revenue_clean'].mean()
print(f'Mean revenue of completed orders (after removing QA): {mean_revenue:.2f}')

# Check if any completed orders have negative revenue
negative_revenue = cleaned[cleaned['revenue_clean'] < 0]
print(f'Number of completed orders with negative revenue: {len(negative_revenue)}')

# Output cleaned data sample
print('\nSample of cleaned completed orders:')
print(cleaned[['order_id', 'channel', 'customer_segment', 'customer_age', 'status', 'revenue_clean']].head())"}
